# Independent Reviewer Run

Act only as the reviewer defined in
`docs/loop-engineering/reviewer-policy.md`.

Repository: `JungCode/zentrox-web`
Issue: `ISSUE_NUMBER`
Pull request: `PR_NUMBER_OR_BRANCH`

Read the issue, manager assessment, repository guidance, pull request body,
complete diff, and validation evidence. Verify scope, acceptance criteria,
correctness, repository conventions, safety boundaries, and the adequacy of
tests or other evidence.

Do not edit files, push commits, approve, merge, deploy, or expand scope. Return
the exact review format required by the reviewer policy, with actionable
location-specific findings ordered by severity. If no findings exist, state
that explicitly and still map the evidence to the acceptance criteria.
